text:
My wife and I finally tried NYAJ. It was very good! I had the BBQ Meatloaf which came with mashed potatoes and green beans. Everything was delicious! The meatloaf was amazing with just a hint of BBQ. I loved it! I paired it with a 22 oz Sam Adam's Winter lager. 

My wife has the Mustard-crusted Chicken BLT which she really liked with her 22 oz Stella. The bread with dipping sauce was amazing. We will definitely be back again soon!!

Decided to support a local restaurant and Tarbush Kitchen was the one. It was an absolutely perfect experience from start to finish. With these strange times and social distancing at the forefront, they were of the upmost in professionalism and made certain that everybody was safe and felt comfortable. The food was phenomenal. It is fresh, it is authentic, it is delicious.I ordered the Shawarma chicken salad, hummus, to jakik, falafel, and chicken kebabs. Each bite was more delicious than the last. We will be putting this restaurant on our regular rotation. The owners were so friendly and took great pride in their establishment.

I ordered some papaya salad and basil chicken to go after working late. The basil chicken was bland, watery, and had ZERO basil in it. The papaya salad had an odd almost chemical flavor to it and I don't know what was wrong with the sticky rice but I had to spit it out because it was so disgusting. I've never been a fan of this place but now I know not to ever bother trying it again. Super disappointing.

This place is great! Love the vibe! Got the rosemary Thai tea and hummus, and loved both. Delicious all around! The hummus had a nice spiciness to it. Loved the bread that came with the hummus. Nice crunchy crust, soft squishy insides and perfectly seasoned with garlic and salt.  I'll be back to try more of their food and the very interesting drink concoctions!

Life changing, amazing, delicious, incredible experience! We somehow got lucky and didn't have to wait long to order and get our food but even if we had waited, I would totally say it's worth it. My friend and I got the Princess, the SEC, and Bonuts- all so good but WOW the Bonuts!!! I want to eat them every day of my life. Do not skip this spot when you're in town!

We have eaten here quite a bit and have gotten takeout a few times since Covid-19 hit.  The food is great - smoked meats are fantastic and the sides are outstanding.  Bread pudding for dessert is usually a good call although mine was a bit dry one time.   Anyway, Sweet Lucy's is highly recommended!!!   And they do a really good job with the parking lot pickup now with Covid-19.

I love this place. They are still operating completely to go. You must call to place an order and pick it up outside. What they desperately need is an online ordering system. When we first tried to call it rang busy for a while, but it was worth the wait and the food was prepared very quickly after placing the order. Vegan options and the food just feels healthy. Not overly complicated or oiled and salted up. I love the (not vegan) egg sandwich and great oat milk latte. They also have fresh vegan donuts!
If you want to include a tip remember to ask when placing the order. We gave our credit card over the phone to pay but now feel bad there was no tipping option!

As someone who works in one of the service industries, I always look for ways to help businesses and their employees. I have not been able to do a lot of dining out or go to bars due to all of the restrictions but decided to go to Buffalo Wild Wings now that some of the restrictions are loosening.  My son and I were seated by a gentleman who was wearing a mask properly (above the nose), but that is where it stopped. Nearly EVERY. SINGLE. EMPLOYEE (Even the ones we saw preparing the food in the kitchen through the wide open doorway) had a mask that was below the nose (and many below the mask) I saw ONE woman in the back wearing a red mask how it should be worn. My son and I were very uncomfortable and decided to just have the food to go. Afterwards, we thought that we probably should have just left without eating, but did not want to cost the business and employees any MORE money than they have already been losing. C'MON restaurants!! If you want people to start to come back, you need to show us you can be trusted to be following healthy standards!
I will take my business elsewhere till Buffalo Wild Wings can be trusted.

Hit and Miss.... 
I've had this place a few times and it's either really good or really bad !! No in between (the potatoes are always the best). Let me tell you about this last time I got food from here To-Go. I ordered the chicken fried chicken and eggs. It came to $17 :-/.  I got home (2 mins away) and started to eat. The potatoes were great the eggs cooked perfect, but that chicken fried chicken literally taste like concrete!!!! It's freaking gross I'm not even sure what piece of chicken this is but it's horrible. So eat at your own risk. I hate that I spent my $17 on this crap.

Great stop on a road trip pre-COVID for that Philly cheesesteak fix. Nothing fancy, but great portions and cool vibe. My sister got pulled pork and it was amazing. Friendly staff. Would certainly stop by again if I'm nearby.

We arrived at 6ish. We was seated in a timely manner. Our waiter was very nice and attentive. I ordered the Burnt end brisket combo. With cole slaw and bake beans. My husband ordered the Rib/pulled pork platter with Mac/cheese, firecracker green beans. The food arrived fast. And looked delicious. I was starving hadn't ate all day so I was ready to dig in. Disappointed to say the least!!! It was cold. And the sides was Luke warm. Of course we sent it back. The second round was worse than the first. Ribs full of fat. My brisket still cold. We spoke with the manager and canceled our whole order. We did have to pay $14 for a Heineken. Which we did! We still tip our waiter and left. The manager was a little rude. When she brought our ticket back to us. Probably upset that we didn't like the food. That's not our problem. That's hers. Serve hot food!!!! Who wants cold barbecue. We don't!!!

Intriguing Pizza shop on the street I frequent most in South Philly. Outstanding bread is used for their pies and the place is always packed. Warning - they do not serve slices on weekends so your looking at mininum $16 for a plain pie, I got two toppings and it ran me a little over $24.

There pizza is worth trying however the pie I got did not meet my standards as I like my pies with ample and tasty pizza sauce. The sandwiches I hear are spectucular and I will return to try them however as far as the pies I would go with a speciality pie next time and update review accordingly. 

Ever since this neighborhood joint was reviewed by barstool and the clip went viral there has been a line around the block so expect a 30-45 minute wait on average.

It is up to you if you are willing to wait in the jam packed smokey interior with no seating. Next time I go I am going to play it smart and hit a neigborhood bar while I wait and pro tip you can bring your pie to Garage Bar and eat it as they do not offer food.
Great family packs available during the stay at home order. We ordered the fajitas for 4 pack and it was delicious!! Great job!
Food is good for suburb sushi, however giving 3 stars because they will always ask to tip the chef for take out. Super awkward. I will usually tip but on my own accordance, I do not like to be asked.

This is definitely the best Middle Eastern restaurant in Tucson. I lived in Turkey for a few years and really came to love the food there. Although many Middle East foods are similar there are distinct and very different dishes that are made in each country. My favorite dish is called Iskender; it is a base layer of buttered pita covered with thinly sliced Doner, then topped with a homemade yogurt and tomato sauce. And the meat is freshly prepared at the restaurant, it's not brought from a third party vendor. The customer service is top notch! All of the staff go above and beyond.  Your beverages always stay full, the food comes out piping hot and they provide you with more food then you can actually eat at one sitting. Another great attribute about this restaurant is the bathrooms are nice and classy and always sparkling clean!  The prices are really good for the quality and the amount of food you get. So if you're in the area stop and check it out and tell them "Murhaba" or hello in Turkish!

This place is a gem, and you get a lot of bang for your buck. I ordered the London Calling and received a heaping plate of delicious [appropriately battered] fish and chips. The cocktails are delicious and affordable. Our server was friendly and attentive. I couldn't have asked for a better experience and will be back again.
Horrible, messed up the whole line. They were putting the wrong orders on other people's trays. One word to sum up this place.... Chaos
I tried the ricotta pancakes today! Sooo yum! Highly recommended!!

We had a reservation for 8:30pm.  Arrived a few minutes late at 8:44 and the manager called us as we were walking up and said they had decided to close the kitchen even though they don't close until 9:30.  No warning or anything - just "we have closed the kitchen".  He could have easily seated us but chose not to.

A quick visit to a hidden Gem. I was wowed by the selections. They have a plethora of prepared food to purchase. To include Italian pastas, risotto, cookies, olives. Pick up your Italian imported items. The customer service was great, attentive and responsive and friendly. We'll be back.

I managed to get a reservation for a Friday night to see what the hype was about and I left being very satisfied with the pizza. The pizza is difficult to describe for me as I feel it is unlike any pizza I have had before. I think the cheese and spices used are the real standouts. One pizza is plenty for two people so I feel the pricing is completely reasonable. Customer service was very good despite the craziness of the place. Whether you come out thinking it is the best pizza is up to you but it is definitely some of the best you will have in Philly.

Found this place online looking for something new to eat, walked in and it smelled great! Fresh veggies, and delicious sauces to choose from, me and my bf eat here almost everyday, we love it. The staff is friendly and its clean, i would recommend trying it out if u like fast fresh food with alot of flavor.

When I'm craving for a good pizza, I always turn to Happy Italian. 

We started our meal with the burrata cheese dip that is the best starter. The bread was toasted to perfection and complimented the dip.

Definitely order this as your starter!

Our entree was a pepperoni and pineapple pizza on neopolitan crust. The price to add just pineapples was kind of ridiculous as it's 2.25 per item which is odd as any other topping costed the same.

They really need to revamp this portion as this was the only negative.

The pizza has a great flop, beautiful pepperoni flavour and had too much of a crunchy crust for my liking.


Overall this is the pizza place to satisfy cravings.

The food delicious.  This is one of my favorite taco places.  I have been working my way down the menu and the only thing that I have not liked are the chicharron tacos.  I ordered one and basically they just tossed crunchy pork rinds on the taco.  I had never had them like this.  I was definitely not a fan.  Usually the chicharron is cooked in a sauce.

I found this restaurant on yelp after searching for something close to our hotel.  It was a easy chose since it had great reviews and it would be my fiance's first time trying Mediterranean food.  The place is cute and had plenty of eats inside and a few tables outside.  The customer service was excellent and I appreciate the complimentary citrus infused water.  I thoroughly enjoyed my food and so did my hunny.  The wait wasn't long at all. Thanks Falafel Inn for making my fiance a Mediterranean food lover.
Best breakfast sandwich & home fries I've had yet in South Jersey! Will be back!!Best breakfast ever!!!
This place is reeeeeally good! Rolls are fair size, prices are affordable, staff is very kind, and the atmosphere is really cozy. Will definitely be back!
An oldie, but a goodie. Always consistent. Great place for lunch with clients or alone.

Tasty, yummy biscuits, piled with whatever you choose. I think everyone should try at least once. Not cheap though and condiments coat extra if you want jam?? Kinda chintzy to not include jam but still worth going.

I usually get chicken fried rice to go when I pass through Philly. Today I had time to sit and dine. Tried the sushi and pad Thai. Sushi was fantastic! I had the dragon roll. Fresh and flavorful, with lots of fish and no excess amounts of rice. The pad Thai was good, but more sweet than spicy. I probably wouldn't get that again. Love the food here, but it is pricey.

lunch time! i loveee hibachi. i've been here a few times to grub for lunch and dinner and i'll keep coming back as long as they keep it up! when i first ever came they were actually finishing up some remodeling? they're done now it's nice inside, clean nice to look at and simple! each hibachi place generally has its own flavor pattern this one models the popular favorite (i won't name) but i am always greeted and seated immediately. I have never waited more than 10mins for a chef to arrive at my table. the cocktails are reasonably priced at $7! 

my server was nice and attentive . my soup and drink were both brought out immediately. the food didn't take any time at all. since it wasn't busy

I have been known to be quite the connoisseur of buffalo chicken wings in my time. It was all I would eat as a child going out to restaurants. And if there is one thing I have taken away in all my years, it's that Culpeppers is my go-to when I'm craving tasty wings. 

I've tried wings at pretty much any bar I've frequented, ever, and these are still my number 1. They are consistently on top every time I order them. Of course, it's the only thing I've tried here, other than the fries so I cannot really speak to any of the other food offerings. But I know enough to say confidently, try their original Culpeppers recipe and you can't go wrong. You will not be disappointed. They are never too dry, or too soggy, and they're always crispy and mild bringing out the best flavors. 

That combined with their delicious waffle fries could never be a disappointment for a solid meal. I'm not always a fan of the atmosphere. It seems dead often enough or full of rowdy sports fans and parking is a pain. None of that really leaves much to be desired. But I've found the service to always be consistently good and the wings alone are worth a visit. 

I've never been disappointed yet.

Just ordered a Large Italian Salad for lunch. It is huge!  Very good flavor. All of the ingredients are fresh. Generous portions of red pepper strips, artichoke hearts, grape tomatoes and several other toppings. I did not add chicken and there's plenty to eat without it. But it would probably be a great addition. The dressing was also very flavorful and there was enough to coat everything. 

Everything I've had here has been good. I can't eat bread so this was a fallback but I'll definitely be getting it again!

Ownership changed in latter part of 2019.  What was good under the original owners has been made better by the current ones.  I imagine building on the original owners' dream may have been a reason why the seller chose these buyers.  Extra star added for making it work in these difficult times for eateries in addition to good eats.

OBSERVATIONS OF 'WASSUP' NOW: 

*Sweet pies are plentiful and include even more options than before. A round of applause earned from this fruit pie fan-atic that the Boysenberry and Marionberry pies this summer were loaded with fruit and just sweet enough to let the berries be the stars and not overwhelmed by sugar.  Their Key Lime pie is luscious.

*Savory pies - including hand pies and whole pies - have been added.

*Cheesecake offerings have been expanded and I cannot remember a better cheesecake in all my years of eating them than the huckleberry one here this summer.

*They are currently working on savory pie appetizers to develop some for holiday use.  

*They are doing daily take out hot meal options (they change daily and see their menu here https://www.boisepieco.net/ ).  It works best to order these a day ahead but if you have your order in by 11a on 'day of' pick up it will be ready to pick up between 3p and 4p.  Sized to serve four, the family take out meals are only $29.99.  They also offer some 'for two' dinner options and boxed lunches.

*They continue to offer sandwiches. 

*They also make specialty coffee beverages and craft bottl
Great place and awesome food. Love the apparel and bigtruck coffee bar hats are sweet (although I didn't see any this trip in. I want to buy some for my family) great place that I highly recommend!

Finally , real pizza in central Indiana. Everything else around here is crap. Rosati's is hands down the best, unless your a fan of crappy "trendy" puzza places or tasteless sauce and crust this place is the best

I work right down the street, so this is a frequent lunch spot for me. I usually order take out and the service is always pleasant. They literally have the best salads in town. So delicious. Club sandwich is delicious, and very filling. The roasted red pepper soup special is to die for. The crimson broccoli pasta is also delicious. ALL of the pizzas are amazing. One of my favorite places in town to eat. Definitely recommend.

Justine has amazing steaks and good cocktails specially for those ones who like fruity/sweet cocktails. The price is a little high for what you order and the atmosphere but generally I'm happy with Justine.
Tasty Kaftah burger pita and fries - yummy.  We also ordered the falafel and tabbouleh.  The parsley hummus on the lamb burger was so good!  Will be back!

This mall is not close to any Downtown hotel but rather a $30 Uber ride each way for stores with dubious outlet mall pricing as with all outlets know your merch before going to spot a rip-off 
If you stay at the massive Gaylord complex its still a shuttle ride away and is in need of a refresh!  Beware theres no other shopping downtown so this is it for shopping in Nashville
Absolutely the best food in Nashville! The MEATLOAF is direct from the kitchens of Heaven. We will be back.
Atmosphere is great for dating, coconut chicken taste pretty good, and serving portion is huge.

Stopped in while on a long bike ride. I had a taste for sushi, so was hoping for something savory and delightful.

The good:
The outside seating, the inside ambiance are delightful. The staff was polite and attentive.

The meh:
The Philly roll was just average. The rice seems slightly under-cooked and had no taste, as though it was made without any vinegar. Roll temp and ingredients were tepid. The food experience was no better than if I had made the roll at home.

The bad:
The only soda-like drinks are organic and $3.50. I overheard one 'mom' remark after she saw the drink prices that they should have just ordered water. It was $17.50 for the adults and 3 young kids.
*I had water.

Fun, eclectic atmosphere with indoor and outdoor seating. Plenty of options on the menu for those wanting a more traditional breakfast or a Southwest influenced breakfast. Highly recommend trying the cornmeal pancakes...at least one!

Very old school feel to this place. Service snappy and quick.  

We ordered the fried mushrooms which reminded us of an old school supper club from back in the day. Very hot and crispy! Yum!

Next up was the blue ribbon fried chicken for other of us. WOW!  This fried chicken actually had some great flavor, and the hush puppies great as well. The other sides we got weren't anything memorable. But everything else really good.

Was told 1hr for delivery. 
It's now 2hrs 15m later and no pizza in sight. 
Don't bother

** update ** after contacting Patxi's and being told 3 separate times since the initial review that our pizza would be here in 10 minutes - we still have no pizza. 

A literal no show after making promises it would be here. Now there is no answer on their phones. 

Just be honest - simple equation for running a business.

I was very pleased with my takeout order from Cafe Roma. I ordered a small gulf shrimp pizza, but I subbed the olive oil base for tomato sauce, & I added artichokes. It was delicious!! My boyfriend ordered a grilled chicken sandwich, which was HUGE, and a side Caesar salad. We were both pleasantly surprised with the portion sizes, and are ecstatic that they stay open so late!!

This is a great auto service center. The entire staff is knowledgable, friendly and helpful. We bring both our vehicles in for all our auto needs and maintainence. Whenever issues arise above and beyond the original maintainence occur we get a courtesy call and they respect our decisions on having work donel I can't imagine taking our business any place else.

Went into eat on Thursday night, had hummus and chicken. The food was good as always, but our server, Jennifer, was absolutely amazing. Thank you for being one of the best servers we've had in a long time there!
I always come here to bring my mom lunch to work and she absolutely loves the BLT. No complaints and costumer service has always been amazing.
We have now tried about half of their menu and we are yet to be disappointed. You should def give them a chance! Also, their prices are very reasonable!

Clean beautiful place. Food and drinks were very tasty. Menu changes frequently though. Make sure you look at the alcohol menu. The drinks are def worth it. Also not crowded during the week which makes the service faster :)

This place was such a great experience. The restaurant had a great atmosphere and very clean. The waiter was so friendly and fast, which is such a refreshing change in Tucson. I even had the pleasure of meeting the owner while I was there. My daughter has recently applied and interviewed to work there and I really hope she's hired. Phenomenal place!

Very professional service. The food is prepared with details not missed. Their red sauce is quite good if you like a hint of mint. Chicken parmigiana is one of my favorites. The lasagna is probably their weakest dish, it tasted "doughy", like it had been stuffed with bread crumbs. However great experience and highly recommend.

We didn't know we needed Tibetan food until White Yak cooked for us. EVERYTHING on the menu is well-prepared and delicious. We always order the gyuma, a spicy sausage appetizer that comes with a couple of dipping sauces. My daughter, the pickiest of eaters, adores the chicken momo (dumplings). The shatrak and pinsha are outstanding and are our favorites. The phaktsee, sauteed spicy pork bacon, sounded delicious, and although it was beautifully prepared, I may not order this again. It was a bit too salty and the thick bacon was chewy. Many vegetarian options are available, of course, and we're ready to try more of those now.

Hooooo boy, this place is wonderful. Started with the pan fried shrimp and pork dumplings... Amazing (and what a cool way to prepare/plate it). Then I ordered the beef chow fun (baller) and wife got the dry chili chicken (dope). We were warned about the spice - and it certainly IS spicy - but the flavor is also excellent. Last, and absolutely not least, we finished things with the coconut ice cream (DAMN). Not really a dessert guy, but that shit slapped. We'll be back for everything else. Damn (again). Bonus was getting to see the chef/owner step in and expo for a few minutes toward the end of the evening. It's clear he demands perfection, and you can taste it in the food.

This was my first time ever eating at Anthony's and it was fantastic. From the food to the service it was great. I believe Tyler took care of us and was very pleasant and good with the kids. One of the main reasons we'll be back. 6/5 stars!
Very Clean, chill atmosphere, great customer service wish I could give 10 stars. Servings are huge we got mediums and didn't finish it. So come w appetite.
COVID NIGHTMARES!! No masks were being worms- people weren't coughing. I meant the food was also gross but JESUS - this place was a health risk the second you walked in. STAU AWAY!!!

The new location is fabulous and glad we found you! I always enjoyed the location by base and food truck, but this is great food with great ambiance and so happy to have this option. The stone grill option was fun and well worth the little bit extra for a melt in your mouth steak.  the fillet

Ordered empanadas by delivery from this place, and they are seriously amazing! We shared a half dozen, and I tried the pollo and suiza empanadas. Both were flavorful and absolutely amazing. I also love how they have a unique shape for each flavor! Prices are very reasonable as well. I'm definitely going to want to order more, or try their food in person once that is safe.

This place was one of my favorites when I visited NOLA. The food in this town is fabulous, but when you pair it with great service and people like Lynn who go out of their way, it's worth every penny. We had a crawfish and shrimp boil and jambalaya with grilled shrimp skewers! DELICIOUS ALL AROUND. Also, if you have a sweet tooth give their bread pudding a try, I loved it.  Happy eating!
Fantastically authentic and delicious Mexican food. A true gem. They are doing everything RIGHT.

Good food, nice people and service in a humble setting. 
If you like to try different cuisines, Ethiopian/African cuisine might be among the oldest in the world inspiring Indian food recipes and many others as well. 

They do have gluten free and vegan friendly options. Just ask if you want one. The rice is fragrant and well prepared. The bread is fermented and could be requested as per the need. We took a veggie combo, and they have family combo or individual items to pick from as well. We ordered vegetarian sambusa (lentil filled samosa) however they do have meat filled sambusa to pick from as well. Be careful while dipping in the sauce as one may find it spicy. 

There is a variety in their menu and overall it is pocket friendly. I would recommend them if you want to try Ethiopian cuisine in Boise area.

Round Table is now offered on DoorDash and this location was available to place an order with. It was accepting orders until 9:30 PM - at 9:15 I placed my order, received confirmation and my card was charged. At 9:45 PM I was notified my order was cancelled due to the restaurant being closed (they close at 10pm) but really that shouldn't matter since I was 15 minutes within the cutoff. Very disappointed - you'd think during Covid they'd accept all the orders they can get. Hopefully my card is refunded ASAP

Having had Jamaican food all over Jamaica from Montego Bay to Kingston and in Toronto, South London and Brooklyn, I can say that this place is proper.  The jerk sauce isn't too salty like it typically is and has a nice sweet and spice balance.  I prefer my jerk sauce more on the sweeter side.  The only improvement I can suggest is I'd rather have creamy coleslaw than cabbage.  The chicken was nice and moist and tender and the baked mac and cheese was nice and light and super fluffy, just how I like it.  It was on par with the best baked mac and cheese in NYC that I've had in Harlem.  Highly recommended.

The WORST customer service I've ever experienced!  The fact that Southern Hospitality is their name is laughable. Not to mention the prices are steep for what you get. I will never return and would not recommend waiting your time or money here. Many other places with much better food and service in the area!
First time to this restaurant. Food product was great as was the service. Owners are very personable and friendly. Wish we had one in CO.

I ordered a 12 piece spicy tenders yesterday evening. When I got them home to eat, I couldn't believe it!!!
Instead of Chicken Tenders, I received Boot Leather Strips!!! Absolutely inedible!!!
    I Love Popeyes!!! But to receive and purchase such incredibly awful & inedible eats has me so disparaged! Questioning whether ir not to patron this establishment ever again. So very disappointed!!! Not to mention that I tried to order popcorn shrimp and they said they had been out if shrimp for 3 months!!!
       Seriously Not Haappy!!!!!!!

Today I had the worst service from here ever the tall light skin girl with braid and headphones their around 3pm on 3/19/2020 just let her go not a good rite had such attitude never a hello or what would you like rudely asked me how many I won't and still stuffed them all in a bag she threw around frosting all over the bag why not put in a plastic container she must not know I come here at least once a week I was disappointed I love showing off these donuts and sharing the joy from there delicious  taste but this bull shit she threw in this bag is not worthy of sharing just overly mistreated my food like why ma'am what did I do to you if you wanna be home leave and be job less

This place was a treat. The green onion cakes are delicious with lots of green onions. They were probably the best that I've eaten, although I don't eat them too often.  I also ordered a bowl of hot  and sour soup and it was only $3.00! A great deal and it was also excellent. It wasn't overly hot for hot and sour soup but of course hot and sour soup is always quite spicy.  This bowl was full of flavour. I am looking forward to another bowl soon.   We mainly bought take-out frozen for eating later at home. The green onion guy (he's not green at all though) very carefully explained how to cook each item we bought. He was so nice that I could see why he's so well known. This is a destination cafe that anyone who enjoys green onion cakes and/or hot and sour soup must try. I would be a regular customer if he was on the south side. Five stars out of five.

Twice now we have wasted our time attempting to goto the Madeira Beach location only to find they were closed when we arrived well within the posted open times.  There are other local seafood companies who want the business and we will use them.

This is my favorite Tucson Nico's. I know they are mostly all operated separately but have the same name/same sounding name. 

Everyone has been friendly and the food is always good - usually I get breakfast burritos or regular burritos. I really appreciate their COVID precautions with outside seating, plexiglass near the register, all employees I've seen have masks on and I've also seen hand washing. 

On my most recent visit, we got a carne asada burrito with no pico (prefer to add salsa) and a red chicken & bean burrito. Both were so good. The chicken was saucy, but super flavorful and I add the red salsa for some more spice. Overall, delicious!! I'll be back again soon!
The best breakfast in town!!! Family owned and amazing food. Huge selection on their menu and everything is good. Can't go wrong.

We had a wonderful 19th anniversary here. We ate upstairs all by ourselves outside on the deck. The goat cheese salad and clams for appetizers. Then, eggplant rollotini and flank steak special. Finished with chocolate mousse cake. Everything was excellent. Can't forget the absolutely perfect chocolate martini!!! Will definitely be back!!
Always great food, taste is top notch here, service is usually pretty good. Prices and portions are reasonable. Always a good experience. Full bar. Daily specials

This restaurant is good for happy hour or dinner, the menu is good and the happy hour amazing! The oysters are big and good deal and they have wednesday steak night that is good too, I recommend it for sure! Now is one of my regular restaurants with some friends

This was an impromptu dinner after arriving in the city. 

We started with deviled eggs and pimento cheese. The crusty bread was delicious. 

The cheesy grits were meh. The pimento cheese was kind of plopped on top and didnt blend well.  The catfish was fresh though so really good. 

I cant even remember what I ordered. No wait... it was crab claws and picled peas. I was actually pleasantly surprised. 

Service was very friendly and they kept our glasses full.
Literally the worst service and food I've ever had. Never returning. Our waitress was beyond rude and not tentative at all. The food made me scheeved out

Hello outback steakhouse,  in Springfield we have  been going to the same restaurant for years never had a problem. Still don't. We ordered a huge curbside last night. Service was impeccable, food was amazing. It's hard to get a huge order like that without messing up one thing. Everything was perfect. From the apps to the salads our steaks were all cooked perfectly and we ordered six steaks filet mignon. And one child she loves her ribs.Just wanted to thank the outback steakhouse staff for a wonderful meal. Can't say enough.   Thank you guys and girls   Especially during this crazy time in our world. You made our day much better yesterday thank you again. Linda
Delicious Banh mi and boba tea, can't wait to try more items from the menu!super easy to order pick up
This place is AWESOME! Locally owned and operated- wait staff was very attentive and friendly. Good menu selection. This is a fantastic place you won't regret!!
Visited yesterday from Chicago, food was decent, building needs to be updated, but did see insects in the bathroom unfinished portion of building visible. Expected more.

Brennan's such a nice restaurant in New Orleans. We made reservations a few months in advance just to make sure we came here and I'm glad we did. The service at Brennan's is great and the food is delicious everything I tried was flavorful and fresh and the best part of our meal dessert!!! The banana foster is so yummy and as they prepare it for you table side they tell you the story of how it was created. I definitely recommend this place for breakfast, lunch or a romantic dinner you won't regret it.
The service at this location was outstanding. The food was great. We ordered fried and the Cheeseburgerfi. It's located conveniently address the street from the reading market.

Was craving an authentic "California-style" Mexican burrito night after a long day of quarantine studying.
Ordered for the first time via Grub hub and we walked over to this neighborhood spot.
In regards to timing - it took about an hour to have the order made; granted it was a busy saturday night in Philadelphia and many grub hub/uber eats drivers outside waiting for orders. Staff was very friendly when we arrived & gave us an appropriate estimate of how long the food was going to take.
The Food
- Nachos (without meat): Excellent; great flavoring of beans, cheese, and jalapenos
- Wet Burrito: AMAZING; felt like I was back in california eating in a hole-in-the-wall burrito. Flavors were excellent & savory every bite.
- Chicken Burrito: Not as flavorful, but also quite yummy. 

Overall - we thoroughly enjoyed and would say it is the best mexican take-out restaraunt in philly we have thus far tried!

So much potential with a name like Funky Monk, but this bar is just a well dressed college bar with higher prices. No Belgian beers are offered and their beer offerings are about as good as Chili's. The service was sufficient, but not what I'm looking for in a beer bar or a place called Funky Monk.

Simple but great authentic mexican cuisine. Wood tables make this cantina super casual. Good margaritas made with Blue Agave Tequila. Great assortment of salsas. Self serve salsa bar. Hard working staff.  You order at the counter and take a number. Food comes out in pieces but everything was so good. Four of us had Chicken Fajitas, Enchiladas suizas, and Chicken Tacos. We Tried to order Tacos Pastor but they were out of pork. Everything is covered at the counter as there is no table service. Also young lady taking orders struggled with our special requests. Not her problem as I need to brush up on my Spanish as my son was laughing at my lame attempts. It was cold otherwise you have to try their outdoor patio. Watch the back parking lot as we struggled to get out once we parked back there. Very tight. Thanks for a good night

Booked the sunset jazz cruise without dinner. Arrived early and it was not crowded during the week. Had a great time with my family. The live jazz band was lovely and speakers at volume everyone could enjoy.  We walked around and took pictures and videos from all available angles.  

We did not buy drinks or food and were not charged for water. The dinner guests do come out from the dining area onto the deck you are enjoying so it does get a bit crowded thereafter but in our case it was during the week so it wasn't terribly crowded (plenty of seating and standing room). 

They do sound their "horn" when there are nearby vessels.  I happened to be in the wrong place lol but that was the only real complaint I had. However, what made up for it is those on the vessels tend to interact with you lol.  We had dancing men and others waving us on!!  

Their competition "Natchez" is always cruising nearby but it makes a lovely photo opportunity of steamboat on the Mississippi while you are on one.  

The souvenir photo is $24 you pay cash, credit or debit.  We had a lovely photo and great experience so I did purchase. 

Overall, worth it!  It is a bit pricey, find discount and book online to get boarding pass early. Mix and mingle away from your group just a bit and when you recollect each has an experience to share.  That's what we did. Our photos and videos are amazing because we were each in a different place just for a short while. I made a new friend and got to meet the crew a bit
I loved it!  Me and my son went and the sushi and service were great!  We got all-you-can-eat and ate so much!  We are now making it s once a month tradition!

I got "In the buff", I could hardly finish it!! I can make waaaaay better mac and cheese at home!! The cheese is not good at all, it tastes plasticity, no soul whatsoever! This is my first time EVER writing a review. Ordered on postmates and wasted $17.

We went to Ruth Chris on Saturday to celebrate my son's 15th birthday. 
Our server was very attentive and the food was delicious as expected. My parents joined us that night and my Dad really enjoyed the lobster bisque in addition to his perfectly cooked filet. My mother loved her crab cakes - I sampled and they were very good.  
At some steakhouses I can order something other than a steak but not here. Hands down Ruth Chris has my favorite steaks. 
I was going to give 5 stars on this review until a friend and I tried to eat here without reservations on a Wednesday night.  I felt like the women at the hostess stand were a little rude when inquired about open tables in the bar area.  We ended up leaving after feeling that our business was not wanted.  I'll go back in the future but not without a reservation.  
Update 1/31/20. 
Still love the food but what happened to your wine list?!?! I had  dinner here a few weeks ago and enjoyed a fabulous bottle of 8 Years in the Dessert.  I'm now disappointed with current opttions.  
However my filet and crab cake were delish. Here's a tip - order the creamed spinach without cream!!! So, so good and much lighter

Unfortunately I am in the same boat as those wondering how Golden Dragon receives such high Yelp reviews.  In fact, I am so perplexed about the reviews vs. the food we received, it has prompted me to write my very 1st review!  We love Asia Wok in Brownsburg, but wanted to try something new. Decided on Golden Dragon solely based on other reviews online!  The bulk of our order is now in the trash can, and we followed up by getting food from another restaurant.

I ordered the Kung Pao Chicken.  My main complaint with the dish was the chicken pieces were so small and fried, you could not tell what type meat it was.  

The other dish we ordered was Orange Chicken.  The breading was so thick, it made up the bulk of each piece of 'meat'.  And again, the chicken was unrecognizable and actually tasted like processed meat.

The Crab Ragoons most likely receive 'best' reviews because the filling has A LOT of sugar.  The spring rolls were typical. No complaints. The 'fried rice' was really just yellow rice.  

To say we were disappointed is an understatement,  If you do visit, I recommend something that does not contain fried chicken (note: ask if the chicken is friend before you order. Their menu picture of the Kung Pao Chicken is unfried, which is what I thought I'd get :/ ).  

The good news is Asia Wok does not have to share our business! :)

Dan and I were in town going to the annual wiener dog race and we needed something to eat first so we came here! What a cute little joint with the most colorful decorations and tables! I got enchiladas and Dan got tacos - both scrumptious!
All I ask is for common courtesy..."thank you" or "you're welcome" by the lady taking my money.

Absolutely delicious!!! This restaurant has been recently renovated and looks so fresh! It's the perfect place for some delicious bites and great wine to go with it. Friendly, attentive service, very clean and tables are socially distanced already. They have a great patio for those warmer lunch times. 

I had the lamb popsicles, they were so good! Must be eaten hot so eat these first! Then I had the calamari and, WOW! These calamari are one of my favourites so far. They have a Portuguese flair with olives and tomatoes, delicious.  And to finish I tried the fries which were light and fluffy on the inside and crispy on the outside! Definitely recommend this place if you're downtown and want some Portuguese inspired cuisine.
Is a neighborhood hangout and visited by many locals.  The pizza is just OK but they serve many different beers.

UPDATE: they no longer serve Brunch... their lunch/Dinner is only sub-par.  When we asked the management about it they were very shady giving the same reason over and over that they now focus on the rest of menu.

We won't be coming back. Thanks for good food in the past 





Best Smyrna, Tn BRUNCH AND BREAKFAST 

After being fed up with other breakfast places on the weekends, on a whim we tried Hickory Falls.  We were so overwhelmed we go EVERY Sunday.  

There's NEVER A WAIT!  Food is amazing and prices are AFFORDABLE for Steak and Pork chop breakfast!

HIGHLY recommend for breakfast!

So another shop owner surprised my shop with lunch one day. Pizza was great, wings were amazing. So i wanted to do the same. Went and got 6 pizzas, lots of wings to surprise one of my venders and from all the thank you i got i can only expect they were as pleased as we were.  This is my new go to. Thank you guys

OMG.... this place rocks.... I've been here only 2 times and the food and service exceeds my expectations every time. The staff is super friendly, social distancing and cleanliness is a super plus here. Even the workers practice social distancing within one another.

The first time I came here I had dinner and the second time I had takeout food for lunch...  the food portions are so huge I can eat 2-3 meals from a single meal. I had. A salad that I eat 3 different times from it. The prices are super reasonable also. 

In conclusion you get first class service and five star dining at a super reasonable price.

Worst dining experience ever!!!

I've been a regular at Columbia Restaurant at Sand Key for the past five years, however, today's visit on 6/16/19 was a total disaster.  We were a party of five, and the total bill including tip was $263.61.  The problems encountered were as follows:

1.  We ordered two Sangria Pitchers.  In the past when Sangria was ordered, the ingredients were explained, and the liquor was poured directly from the original bottles.  The server, James C. did not say a word, and liquor was poured out of two shot glasses. One was a clear liquid, and the other was dark. Was it Torres 5 year brandy like in the past? What in the world was I being served? Not acceptable!!!

2.  We had ordered three separate Tapas totaling $34.00, however, we were charged for a sampler platter for $36.00.  Not acceptable; a total ripoff here!!!

3.  The vegetables served ( carrots and green beans ) were actually cold and raw!!!  Not acceptable!!! 


4.  The Marilyn & Joe dish was simply terrible.  It was a big sloppy mess which was unrecognizable and just dumped on a plate.  It no way resembled what was described on the menu, and I took one bite, and that ended my meal for the evening.

5.  The server ( James C. ) was extremely pesty, and we were constantly asked what we wanted the minute we sat down at the table, and subsequently after every course was served. I was entertaining guests out of town, they were not familiar with the drinks, tapas, and entrees, so we didn't need to be
We ordered the wine plate the bad thing is our kids could have made us a better one using a lunchable.

What a great experience we had here. Ordered our food at the bar inside. We shared the meat board and I had a side salad with a grapefruit flavored beer. I was with a group of 5 and we sat outside and enjoyed the weather. We went on a Saturday night Memorial Day weekend at around 630. The meat board was awesome and the service was great. Very attentive. They have board games that we played and we had a lot of fun. There were a lot of people there and we enjoyed talking to the other patrons. I would definitely recommend this restaurant as a must see in St. Louis

Haven't been to Cheesecake Factory for any type of meal in years - it was time to try it again. We arrived around 5:15 on a Friday evening as the restaurant was just starting to get busy. Our group was 7, but didn't need a reservation, and were seated right away. Service was great - drink orders were taken right away. They have a very extensive menu with something for everyone ! We split an order of chicken sliders, added a cup of clam chowder, and of course finished up with a big slice of Chocolate Hazelnut cheesecake. Food order took an extra long time to come out from the kitchen. Sliders were good especially with the thousand island dressing added - the appetizer order came with 4 sliders. Clam Chowder was loaded with clams but was just OK - I must be spoiled having had some of the best in the country ! Highlight of the dinner was definitely the cheesecake - the Chocolate Hazelnut is one of my favorite flavors. Prices are on the higher side especially since we ordered off the appetizer menu for the meal. Some things about the meal were good, others not, so sticking with a 3 rating - could be better.
$14 for a cheesesteak? I don't think so , I'll make my own with filet mignon for that price !

I've always had super fast service! During the first part of quarantine of course it was an adjustment because everyone wanted pizza. You waited a little but it is worth it. The yummy crusts, fresh ingredients, savory smells and overall prices are great. 

One of the times I went I ordered their cheese pizza and maybe it was the way it was made but something was off. I know traditional Napoletana style pizza and this wasn't it. Maybe a deviation in the style of making it that time? The cheese was very thin, barely any sauce and therefore it resembled a mainly crust pizza - or just the crust. I thought the marinara was more like that, plus some basil. I don't know!  I could have misunderstood. 

Regardless I'd recommend for a quick slice of heaven and kind service. Always a fantastic go-to.

Traveling through St Louis and needed good food quickly. We ordered ahead and got mango green iced tea, dumplings, hand pulled noodles w shrimp, and wonton soup. All of them were delicious. The mango green tea had a floral taste to it. We sat in Martin W Malcolm park and ate under the arch. Good stuff and good portions.

Best hot chicken in Nashville! Go see Cara she'll get you squared away!   For first timers i suggest you start with Mild and go up from there to see how Prince's measures their heat.  I took a co-worker there who though medium would be fine and i should've warned her.  She was sweating and drinking a lot of water.   So for the new people start off your first experience with Milf and enjoy the flavor and excellent chicken and adjust up from there.
The food was great. My only complaint is even though we were under the patio roof, when it started pouring and blowing into our table, no one offered to move us inside.

It's an odd reason, but I mainly came here because I had a T-Mobile Tuesday coupon for $4 off of a purchase at Jamba Juice. Unfortunately, Jamba Juice is not a hugely popular chain in my area, so this is not a place I would return to on a regular basis, despite many of the positive aspects of my experience here. I have been very interested in smoothie bowls for a while now, and although I know that this isn't the focus specifically at Jamba Juice, I did notice that they had a small selection of smoothie bowls.

I decided to order a "Vanilla Blue Sky" smoothie bowl because I saw that it was the bowl with the lowest calories. Only 330 calories for a beautifully-colored bowl with bananas, pineapples, unsweetened almond milk, vanilla coconut milk, blue spirulina, organic granola, strawberries, blueberries, and coconut chips? It sounded excellent to me. It also tasted really, really good.

As a side note, I am suspicious of the calorie count being only 330 calories, as this is likely the lowest I've seen for any smoothie bowl, ever. Nonetheless, the smoothie bowl was incredible and it made me look into purchasing blue spirulina for my own smoothie bowls that I make at home. The prices at Jamba Juice are also better than many mainstream smoothie bowl places. Even at full price, this bowl would be $3 cheaper at Jamba Juice than at other establishments.

I don't specifically have a reason to come back, but if I was in the Willow Grove area for any reason, I'd consider stopping here.

I was back in Smyrna for awhile around lunch time. We lived here for 20 years up until about a year and a half ago. I was "Yelping" looking for reviews of another new restaurant that had opened since we had moved and this one popped up. Me and hot chicken have had this illicit affair going on for a few years now. (I know, it should be hot chicken and I, but hey). Hot chicken is my first love (food that is). I've totally given up on Popeye's. Popeye's is to hot chicken what Chef-Boy-Ardee is to fine Italian dining. They are a "poser" in the hot chicken world. When someone mentions hot chicken, Popeye's just doesn't cross my mind. I saw the reviews for Mack's. The biggest drawback it seems is the wait times and the way the even handle call ahead orders. It seems there is a disconnect between the time the order is placed and the time it is SUPPOSED to be ready. But I am retired - I'm not having to get back to work. TIME - TIME - TIME - IS ON MY SIDE. YES IT IS! I'll wait a good bit for some good chicken. They cook it all fresh. If you are in a hurry, the tenders cook faster.

Turns out it was about 20 minutes. Hot chicken places must have an agreement about how to price their food as they are all generally in the $8 - $9 price range for a breast quarter and a side. white bread and a few pickles. Mack's has 6 levels of heat. I dialed it back one level down from the hottest which is Mack's Revenge (why you mad bro?) to the Mack Attack. Again - crinkle cut fries - the bane of my po

This place, like many others, is my place to go for peking duck. Since 2014, I try to make a trip here everytime I visit philly. Usually takeout to bring back to my family or friends (they love it too!). FYI half duck = one whole plastic takeout container with 5 buns/pancakes, full duck = two whole plastic takeout containers with 10 buns/pancakes

They have options for buns or thin pancakes. I can never choose betwen the two so I always ask for half and half when I call. They are usually pretty receptive.

In terms of COVID pre-cautions, I'd say theyre doing their due dillegance. There are social distancing lines outside of the restaurant, screens providing safety for both workers and customers, and signs with directions on how to order and pick up your food!

This is the my first time ever making a review because I'm so disappointed! 
Me and my daughter wanted to try a different pho restaurant so we decided on this one. When we walked in, the restaurant smelled so bad like it reeked of urine. We were seated instantly and given our menus. That was it! Nobody came back to ask for our drink orders and even when we closed our menus to hint that we were ready, no one even turned their backs. What I mean by that, is that there were four employees standing at the front desk, and nobody bothered to come and take our order. And no, it was not busy at all. (Maybe two other occupied tables!) 
After ten minutes, we just walked out, and nope they didn't even glance up to ask why we were leaving. I mean if they don't care about their customers, then I don't care to write this review. We own our own business and would never treat our customers this way. I would never go there again and would definitely not recommend it.


So the response from the owner is that "I'm trying to smear the business, and have a wonderful day!" So, "Au K" (the owner), thanks for commenting back and not apologizing for your employee's rude behavior, I can see now where your employees get that from, and yes I will have a wonderful day!
Had a very friendly server. Good atmosphere and I ordered the short rib which was very good considering cost and location

This is my third time patronizing Thai Chef & Noodle Fusion, and will certainly be my last. 
During my last visit I ordered the vegetable Pineapple fried rice. I have a sensitivity to garlic; this dish is cooked in a Garlic Soy-Sauce that upset my stomach and filtered through my pores for days after having it during my second visit. This is not to say the dish was not good, it was very enjoyable and my reaction was no fault of the restaurant nor the chef. 

However, during my visit today, I ordered the pineapple fried rice and asked to omit the garlic Soy-sauce and switch for plain soy sauce. I was told that I couldn't. 
I asked for clarification because I was thoroughly confused on why my dish couldn't be cooked with the same soy sauce that  my husband and I requested (and received) on the side of our Vegetable Spring Roll appetizer. 

After coming back and forth from the kitchen three times, the waitress, while very polite, couldn't properly explain why I couldn't get regular soy sauce in my pineapple fried rice. 
Finally, she said the chef can fry the rice without ANY soy sauce and give us regular soy sauce on the side to mix in ourselves. 

I did not want to be a difficult customer and just switched my order to vegetable Massaman Curry.  Since my husband does not have a garlic sensitivity, he ordered the dish and our food came out within 5 minutes! 

Which alluded to my assumption that their food is not fresh. If that were the case, and the waitress would have explained t
Fresh,hot, authentic food. Great ambiance in the restaurant and the staff is friendly.

We had a late breakfast here after a soccer game and loved it!! We had a group of 10 people and did not have to wait long at all! Everyone enjoyed their inlets, eggs, avocado toast and nothing was greasy! 
The homemade jams are delicious too!!!

Good chicken and waffles at this spot.  It's pretty small so their was wait and the service wasn't quick, though the meal made it worth it!  It's black-owned as well, which in my book is always a PLUS!

.This is the worst McDonald's on the planet they only accept cash all the time they give you no forewarning you're stuck in a line full of a dozen people when you're not prepared because you have a card they're completely unprofessional by not giving you a heads-up and it's the absolute worst customer service in Tampa.

First stop every time I hit NOLA from the airport. Great local taste for cash and carry. Best place to grab a smorgasbord of food, dessert and drinks and take to your hotel and grub. Don't be put off by the local look of the place. Go in and get what you need and head out. ITS DELICIOUS!!!

They have a wide selection of teas and are very friendly! The teas themselves are delicious and they also have smoothies and a selection of vegan and non vegan food. There also sell the tea by loose leaf- if you like tea or are wanting to try something new id definitely recommend!

This is one of my favorite restaurants in Indianapolis! The food is always delicious and the welcoming atmosphere sets it apart. My parents and I have been there multiple times and always enjoy our meal. I highly recommend the antipasto salad and the chicken piccata.
Amazing as always!  Great atmosphere and delicious food.  They are following all Covid protocols.

We came to this place while on a little weekend vacation, it was right across the street and had good reviews. The food here was AMAZING! Really big portions , and the quality was great. My only complaint would be the service, it was busy and our wait wasn't very long-maybe 25 mins on Sunday morning. But we waited a long time for re-fills and didn't see our waitress very many times. I got the cinnamon roll French toast, the whipped cream tasted homemade, it was delicious! If you don't mind the wait and can be a patient human being-definitely worth checking out.

I had heard in the past that this was a good little restaurant.  I have driven by it many times and have always been curious about it.

Since this terrible pandemic hit we have been primarily eating in.  Today for Easter I told my wife and daughter we should order takeout.  She read reviews about this restaurant and they were positive.  

She ordered and I drive here to get our meal.  We ordered a pasta salad, two salads, a chicken rosemarie sandwich, a chicken mushroom sandwich, a hamburger, and a small flat bread pizza. 

The person working there was so nice and professional.  He talked with me for a while and I really liked the look inside the restaurant.  When this pandemic is over and businesses start to reopen we will come here.  He showed me their happy hour menu, and it is on our list of places to go.

I wished the staff a Happy Easter and returned home to eat.  The food was incredible.  The bread was light and fresh.  The meat was juicy, the salads were fresh, and the pizza was delicious.  

We have left overs for another meal.  If you are in the area of Fred Meyer at Linder and Chinden stop by this restaurant.  Great staff and delicious food.  You won't be disappointed.
Our expectations were met again!  Every time we come here we get perfectly cooked delicious burgers!

Another support small business pick up of the 32 oz salsa and fresh warm chips from Brownsburg Iguanas mexican restaurant!  Their salsa is so good, and another way I've used it is adding it to the black bean and corn sausa recipe I make also! Yum!
Great place to eat. Ichibans does it right. The kids love the interaction. Aldin is a superstar chef!!
Came here for my birthday!! Such a beautiful place! The food was amazing and so was the atmosphere!

Great local, bagel company. Solid options for breakfast sandwiches. I typically order the Pacific Sunrise, I can't think of the name of the one my wife enjoys, but it has jalapenos, bell peppers, avocados and a couple of other things. Both sandwiches are good. Bagels are always enjoyable here. Always taste fresh, never over toasted. We've come here for a long time between the south Reno and the midtown location. We will likely keep coming here when we're looking for a light breakfast option.

Wow! I've been here twice now and the food is phenomenal! The portions are huge and everything is delicious. It's a very casual place where you pick your 3 choices from a hot table. Their pork is my favorite anywhere. I just ate there Monday and I can't wait to go back!
I don't know why everyone is so mad. It's McDonald's not Olive Garden. Overall it was good and they got my order right and I sat down. It's very good
Went with co-workers for a team outing. Everyone was extremely happy with their food and also the speed at which it was served.

I was so excited to finally eat at this place after living nearby for 4 months. What a huge disappointment. From the service to the food, nothing was good. Our server was either having a bad day or just rude AF. No hi, welcome, just "what do you want to order"? She literally (no exaggeration), rolled her eyes when I asked what she preferred over two choices. The Gray Whale I ordered was awful. No alcohol at all. The blackened mahi-mahi was like chewing rubber. The hush puppies were burnt. Seriously the best part of my meal was getting the check and leaving.

It may be wonderful and this was our spot we picked to try on our one night in NOLA based on outstanding reviews, BUT thedining room was closed and the neighborhood seemed a little dicey after dark. If we return it will be in daylight hours only.

This is a great place to visit if you are looking to get infected with covid19.  None of the staff were wearing masks and the tables are jammed together with zero thought about social distancing.  Our waitress was nice enough, but she was complaining about phlegm in her throat as she was coughing while taking our order.  The food was served promptly, but it was just average.  The lack of consideration for the health of their own employees and their customers will keep us from ever coming back.
Worst meal I've had in the last 20 years and it's been 20 years I had food poisoning. Freaking terrible!
Great food and service!  Best guacamole and fresh food! If you're seeking delicious Latin food and an awesome rum drink, look no further. Angelo is a terrific bartender!

I love hamburgers so I had to try this place. It was possibly the best burger that I've ever had. The meat was seasoned and cooked to perfection. The hand cut fries were delicious and my drink never ran dry. I highly-highly recommend this establishment.

Hard working staff that managed the phone and in-person orders with efficiency. Lemon chicken had the perfect mix of sweet and savory. General Tao chicken was some of the best we've had in St. Louis. Lo mein noodles were very hearty. We live 25 minutes away but would definitely consider ordering from here again.
Great food and truly authentic Greek. They cook it on the spot keeping it very fresh. Only thing to note is limited space to sit. Great kids menu as well.

Six years ago the owners came here as refugees and they just opened this great restaurant! The servers were very friendly and the portion sizes were huge. I got the Doner and it was very flavorful. Tons of seating and a great ambiance.

This place is pretty good, very nice staff. Place is a little dirty & there was flies everywhere in it, here is one on the window & there were ones dead on the floor, there was one dying on the table as I passed it. Good concept in the restrooms, as yu are leaving, they have sanitary gel so yu can clean yur hands after yu touch the handle, I liked that.

Small restaurant in Mid- City- nostalgic and good is excellent- They made the sandwich Frencheletta famous- there take on muffuletta except on French. Fresh cut fries and soft drinks in a frosted glass.

In my opinion this is the best thai  buffet in the entire state, the green papaya salad is amazing! Also I dont get why there are so many bad reviews regarding the service, they are always super nice to me.

Went back to Devine Bovine Burgers compliments of the owner . I have to say this time was much better . The staff was great , the restaurant was very clean and the food was perfect . The Burgers are so good .

I'm giving Cafe Roma 5 stars because it's a family run business with a lot of personality. I often get their pizza delivered, consistently fast but has been slow. I've found their pizza to be the best when you're planning to have leftovers. The pizza honestly tastes better the next day after being reheated in the oven. They have great pasta options that come with side salads and a cheese bread pizza slice. They also have great subs, particularly the chicken parm. I have had really great experiences with the staff and even when they do mess up they try their best to correct it. I highly recommend this place for take out or delivery.

The food and service here are EXCELLENT!! Stopped in for a feast today (and 2 doggie ice creams) and everyone was VERY happy after our visit! We ordered a kids vanilla cone, dipped in peanut butter, a Hot Russian Burger, a Tom Burger, and a finger steak basket. Everything was fresh and came out incredibly fast for how busy it was and how much we ordered! Can't wait to get back and try more!

Best margaritas ever! Perfectly made not too sweet, very flavorful. If I lived close to here happy hour would be dangerous.

The fish tacos were great- got one grilled and one fried. Grilled is the way to go. Dinner mates got the chicken burritos and another friend got the rose pepper special that was "very hot".  She deceived it as good but only mild (she loves hot food).

The chips and salsa trio were brought out as soon as your seated. All of the salsas tastes fresh and were good.

Can I give zero stars? One star for being held hostage at a booth. 

Cool story, no hostess to greet after waiting for 15 minutes, so we went to the bar. Sat at the bar for another 15 without being offered a drink.. If you want to order more drinks with your dinner, good luck. If you want a warm plate of pasta, keep dreaming. I told a manager my plate was cold and I would've appreciated a microwave. Must've been because it's so crowded... no wait...there was 3 other tables in the place and it still took us over two hours to eat. 

My dinner was cold, the service was awful and impressively rude. Have you ever felt ignored and rushed out at the same time? How about on a Wednesday? 

My husband is a serial over-tipper and and I've worked in food and bev for years, but this might have actually been the worst dining experience we've ever had. Well done, corporate.
